title: kz219-wgs: analysis code for “High-coverage whole genomes of 219 Kazakhs fill a Central Asian gap in human reference panels”
description:
Analysis code for the article “High-coverage whole genomes of 219 Kazakhs fill a Central Asian gap in human reference panels” (Communications Biology, 2026).

Upstream scripts record the commands, software versions, parameters and random seeds used for alignment and variant calling (Illumina DRAGEN v3.10.16; joint genotyping DRAGEN v4.3.6; GRCh37/hg19), annotation (ANNOVAR v2025Mar02), population-genetic analyses (PLINK v1.9.0-b.8 and v2.00a5.12, ADMIXTURE v1.3.0), mitochondrial haplogroups (samtools, BWA-MEM, mutserve, HaploGrep 3) and Y-chromosome haplogroups (Y-LineageTracker v1.3.0). Six Jupyter notebooks produce the figures, tables and Supplementary Data of the article from those outputs.

Individual-level genotypes and participant metadata are not included. Raw reads are deposited in NCBI SRA under BioProject PRJNA1224597.
